key_idea: Enumerate all 21 possible pairs for Bob among the remaining seven digits, keep those whose sorted layout matches the given A/B pattern, and answer only if exactly one pair survives.
sketch: For every a<b in 1..9 distinct from p and q, sort the four cards with their owner labels and compare the label string with the input. Count matches and remember the last one; print it if the count is 1, otherwise -1. Constant time. No real pitfalls beyond printing the smaller digit first.
